title: why are meterBG's not synchronized in NS-Follower mode
symptom: When using an Accu-Chek Guide via Bluetooth, BG records are synchronized to Nightscout and appear as type 'mbg' in MongoDB. However, in NS-Follower mode, these meterBG records are not synchronized to the follower; only sgv's are read/extracted correctly by the EntryProcessor.
evidence_quote: we are using an Accu-Chek Guide via bluetooth and synchonize the BG records to your nightscout instance. Thats running very well and in the mongodb we see all the metering as type "mbg". Now i set up a NS-Follower and encountered that all our meterBG's aren't synchronized to the follower.
